featured_reviews.review_text: Saw their advertisement on Instagram and approached them for my mom. The person who received the call told me to visit their Andheri East Center and also told me that most problems are due to reduction of space or the cartilage thinning in the knee joint. We reached at the centre and met the doctor who seemed to be good and knowledgeable but then the diagnosis was the same what the person on call had told me without even seeing my mom. I felt as if they were all told to emphasise that the only knee problem that a person will have is reduction of gap in between the knee and thinning of cartilage in the knee joint for which they would treat my mom. Next came the payment part and another lady came in and she explained everything regarding the payment and insisted that we take a quick call if wanted to go ahead with 20 sessions and also said that if you take it now this much discount only for today etc. I felt that to be a little bit odd. The amount charged was not small and how would anyone pay so much upfront without even seeing the results just on the basis of hearsay or what they were telling us. We requested for time to make a decision and the lady did not seem to be too happy about it and we were suggested to block few sessions to avail the discount price and to confirm in sometime what we will do. We told her we wanted to find out if insurance covered it but the lady said these charges are usually not covered and we should make the call as soon as possible. She left us to make the decision. Then after 10 mins she came back and started asking about what we had decided. When we told her we would like to book 2 sessions and see how my mom feels and also check if insurance covers this. She told us to pay 5k for those two sessions. We paid and requested that we would want to get those sessions closer to our house for which the lady said that by Monday I will call you and you let me know and then I will transfer your details to the Borivali branch where we can continue treatment. My mom got a free massage session and we left. We decided we will go with just 2 sessions and conveyed the same when we got a call from the same lady on Monday. I was told that since Tuesdays holiday due to Visarjan on Wednesday my moms details will be transferred to respective Center and we will get a call to inform when to take her to Borivali center for her next session. We haven’t heard from them since then. I called their main centre twice on Saturday and I was assured someone from Andheri center will call me, however I am still waiting for the call; haven’t heard from them yet. I am not sure what is happening. Had such high hopes and expectations as I too belong to medical fraternity but totally disappointed with the commercial approach rather than being inclined towards patient care.
